description_sq:
Shesim apartament te tiplogjise 2+1+2 ne Laprake ne rrugen kryesore. Apartamenti eshte i organizuar ne sallonin bashke me kuzhinen, 2 (dy) dhoma gjumi nje korridor shperndares, 2 (dy) tualete dhe nje ballkon. Apartamenti eshte i ri totalosht i investuar dhe i pa banuar me pare.
Zona ofron te gjitha facilitet e mundshme si;
-shkolle 9 vjecare
-kopesht per femije
-universitet
-supermarkete
-qender tregtare,
-banke
-spital
-farmaci
-dalje e menjehershme ne rrugen kryesore
-linje autobusi dhe taksi.
Mundesi shume e mire investimi.
Apartamenti ka drite gjate gjithe dites dhe pamje te lire te qytetit.
Per me shume informacion ose nje vizite ne prone me kontaktoni!
description_en: We are selling a 2+1+2 type apartment in Laprake on the main street. The apartment is organized in the living room together with the kitchen, 2 (two) bedrooms, a distribution corridor, 2 (two) toilets and a balcony. The apartment is new, fully invested and never lived in before. The area offers all possible facilities such as; -9-year school -kindergarten -university -supermarkets -shopping center, -banks -hospital -pharmacy -immediate exit to the main road -bus and taxi lines. Very good investment opportunity. The apartment has light throughout the day and a clear view of the city. For more information or a visit to the property, contact me!
